Arachim doesn’t wait for Jews to find Judaism.
We bring it to them.

For nearly 50 years, Arachim has gone wherever Jews are searching, from Tel Aviv apartments and Galilee moshavim to hostels in the Far East. Through lectures, home programs, personal outreach, and immersive seminars, we give every Jew the space to ask, learn, and discover in a warm, nonjudgmental environment.

And when the seminar ends, the real change begins.

THE ARACHIM JOURNEY

A weekend can open his eyes.
What happens after can change his life.

From discovering Torah to living it.

The first spark

A powerful lecture that challenges what they thought they knew and opens the door to a more purposeful life.

The seminar

Three immersive days with renowned speakers, historians, and psychologists in a warm environment is where change begins.

The days after

Every person gets a mentor who supports and guides them for 2 years as they make changes in their everyday life.

The life that follows

A life of Torah, purpose, and belonging, rooted in a heritage that is finally theirs to live.

$4,200 can fund that entire path for one Jew.
